information: **The admission cost is higher than average due to flying the delegates in from California. Big thanks to Chris and Calvin for making the long trip!** Please plan to arrive at least 15 minutes before your first scheduled event. First-time competitors should be present for the new competitors' tutorial at 8:30 AM.
